categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies the legacy BDB wallet migration parser in src/wallet/migrate.cpp along with its tests.
categories.rationale: Prevents bitcoind from hanging indefinitely or crashing from out-of-memory exhaustion during wallet migration. Malformed or crafted BDB files could bypass earlier checks to trigger exponential DFS, circular overflow loops, and unbounded memory allocation.
